import pytest
from tablefmt import render


class TestJapaneseAlignment:
    """Tests for proper column alignment with East Asian wide characters (Japanese)."""

    def test_simple_japanese_text(self):
        """Japanese text should align properly with ASCII text."""
        result = render(
            [["レポート.pdf", 12], ["notes.txt", 3]],
            headers=["name", "KB"],
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Verify that the separator line and all data lines have consistent column positions
        # The pipe character should align vertically
        assert lines[1].index("+") == lines[2].index("|"), "Column separator not aligned"
        assert lines[1].index("+") == lines[3].index("|"), "Column separator not aligned"

    def test_mixed_japanese_and_ascii(self):
        """Mixed Japanese and ASCII in same column should align."""
        result = render(
            [
                ["レポート_2024.pdf", 12, "2024-11-02"],
                ["notes.txt", 3, "2024-11-20"],
                ["議事録.docx", 48, "2024-10-15"],
            ],
            headers=["name", "KB", "modified"],
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # All lines should have same number of pipes
        num_pipes = [line.count("|") for line in lines]
        assert len(set(num_pipes)) == 1, f"Inconsistent pipe count across lines: {num_pipes}"
        
        # Verify separator line aligns with data lines
        for i in range(1, len(lines) - 1):
            sep_pipes = [m.start() for m in __import__("re").finditer(r"\|", lines[1])]
            data_pipes = [m.start() for m in __import__("re").finditer(r"\|", lines[i + 1])]
            assert sep_pipes == data_pipes, f"Pipes not aligned between lines"

    def test_japanese_with_max_width_truncate(self):
        """max_width should truncate Japanese text properly."""
        # With max_width of 10, "レポート_2024.pdf" should be truncated
        # レ=2, ポ=2, ー=2, ト=2 (8 columns) + _ (1) + 2 (1) + 0 (1) + 2 (1) + 4 (1) + . (1) + p (1) + d (1) + f (1) = 20 columns
        # Should fit "レポー" (6 columns) + "_202" (4 columns) = 10, then add ellipsis
        result = render([["レポート_2024.pdf"]], max_width=10)
        # Should contain ellipsis
        assert "…" in result
        # Result should be valid
        assert len(result) > 0

    def test_japanese_with_max_width_wrap(self):
        """max_width with wrap should break Japanese text at word boundaries."""
        # Note: Japanese doesn't have clear word boundaries by space, so this tests wrapping behavior
        result = render(
            [["レポートと議事録ファイル", "x"]],
            max_width=8,
            wrap=True,
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Should have multiple lines
        assert len(lines) >= 2

    def test_japanese_right_alignment(self):
        """Right-aligned Japanese text should pad correctly."""
        result = render(
            [["a", "レポート"], ["abc", "b"]],
            align="right",
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # The two lines should have consistent column positions
        assert len(lines[0].split("|")[0]) == len(lines[1].split("|")[0])

    def test_japanese_center_alignment(self):
        """Center-aligned Japanese text should pad correctly on both sides."""
        result = render(
            [["レポート"], ["ab"]],
            align="center",
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Both lines should have same length (before trailing space removal)
        # The column should be centered for both
        assert len(lines) == 2

    def test_japanese_with_numbers(self):
        """Japanese text with number columns should maintain proper alignment."""
        result = render(
            [
                ["レポート.pdf", 12345],
                ["notes.txt", 3],
                ["議事録.docx", 48],
            ],
            headers=["filename", "size"],
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Verify no line has trailing spaces before separator
        for line in lines:
            if "|" in line:
                parts = line.split("|")
                for i, part in enumerate(parts[:-1]):
                    # Parts before the last should not end with arbitrary spaces
                    # (they may have padding, but that's intentional)
                    assert len(part) > 0, f"Empty part at position {i}"

    def test_japanese_header_alignment(self):
        """Japanese headers should align with data."""
        result = render(
            [["a", "b"], ["x", "y"]],
            headers=["カテゴリ", "値"],
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Header line should align with data lines
        assert len(lines) == 4  # header, separator, row1, row2
        # Pipes should be in same positions
        header_pipes = [m.start() for m in __import__("re").finditer(r"\|", lines[0])]
        sep_pipes = [m.start() for m in __import__("re").finditer(r"\+", lines[1])]
        # The separator uses + where pipes are, so positions should be close
        assert len(header_pipes) == len(sep_pipes)

    def test_multiple_japanese_characters(self):
        """Multiple lines with Japanese should maintain alignment."""
        result = render(
            [
                ["太郎", "30"],
                ["花子", "28"],
                ["山田太郎", "45"],
            ],
            headers=["名前", "年齢"],
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # All data lines should have pipes in same positions
        pipe_positions = []
        for line in lines[2:]:  # Skip header and separator
            positions = [m.start() for m in __import__("re").finditer(r"\|", line)]
            pipe_positions.append(positions)
        
        # All positions should be identical
        for positions in pipe_positions[1:]:
            assert positions == pipe_positions[0], "Pipe positions not consistent"

    def test_japanese_empty_cell(self):
        """Empty cells with Japanese in same column should work."""
        result = render(
            [
                ["レポート", "data"],
                [None, "other"],
            ]
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Should render without error
        assert len(lines) == 2
        # Both lines should have same pipe position
        for i in range(len(lines) - 1):
            pos1 = lines[i].find("|")
            pos2 = lines[i + 1].find("|")
            assert pos1 == pos2, f"Pipe position mismatch: {pos1} vs {pos2}"

    @pytest.mark.parametrize("text,expected_in_output", [
        ("レポート", "レポート"),
        ("議事録", "議事録"),
        ("カテゴリ", "カテゴリ"),
        ("日本語", "日本語"),
    ])
    def test_japanese_text_preserved(self, text, expected_in_output):
        """Japanese text should be preserved in output."""
        result = render([[text, "value"]])
        assert expected_in_output in result

    def test_japanese_with_ascii_mixed_in_cell(self):
        """Cell with both Japanese and ASCII should align."""
        result = render(
            [
                ["Report_レポート", 1],
                ["data_データ", 2],
            ]
        )
        lines = result.split("\n")
        # Verify alignment
        pos1 = lines[0].find("|")
        pos2 = lines[1].find("|")
        # Positions should be the same (or close after trailing space removal)
        assert pos1 == pos2 or abs(pos1 - pos2) <= 1

"""Tests for proper alignment with wide characters (Japanese, etc.)."""

import pytest
from tablefmt import render


def _visual_width(text: str) -> int:
    """Calculate display width of text in a terminal.

    CJK characters (Japanese, Chinese, Korean) are typically 2 columns wide.
    Most other characters are 1 column wide.
    """
    width = 0
    for char in text:
        if _is_wide_char(char):
            width += 2
        else:
            width += 1
    return width


def _is_wide_char(char: str) -> bool:
    """Check if a character is a wide character in a terminal."""
    code = ord(char)
    # Hiragana, Katakana, and CJK Unified Ideographs are wide
    return (
        0x3040 <= code <= 0x309F  # Hiragana
        or 0x30A0 <= code <= 0x30FF  # Katakana
        or 0x4E00 <= code <= 0x9FFF  # CJK Unified Ideographs
        or 0x3400 <= code <= 0x4DBF  # CJK Extension A
        or 0xF900 <= code <= 0xFAFF  # CJK Compatibility Ideographs
    )


def test_japanese_basic_alignment():
    """Columns should line up when cells contain Japanese characters."""
    result = render(
        [["レポート", 12], ["notes", 3]],
        ["name", "count"]
    )
    lines = result.split('\n')

    # Verify separator line exists and dashes align correctly
    # The separator should be: --------+-----
    # Where 8 dashes correspond to the first column width (レポート is 4 chars × 2 = 8 visual)
    # and 5 dashes correspond to "count" (5 chars × 1 = 5 visual)
    assert len(lines) == 4  # header + separator + 2 data rows
    separator = lines[1]
    assert '-+-' in separator or '-+' in separator


def test_japanese_mixed_columns():
    """Mixed ASCII and Japanese in same table should align."""
    result = render(
        [
            ["レポート_2024.pdf", 12],
            ["notes.txt", 3],
            ["議事録.docx", 48]
        ],
        ["name", "KB"]
    )
    lines = result.split('\n')

    # All lines should have pipe separators at the same column positions
    # Find positions of pipes in each line
    pipe_positions = []
    for line in lines:
        positions = [i for i, char in enumerate(line) if char == '|']
        pipe_positions.append(positions)

    # All lines should have the same pipe positions
    if len(pipe_positions) > 1:
        for positions in pipe_positions[1:]:
            assert positions == pipe_positions[0], "Pipe positions should align across all rows"


def test_japanese_right_aligned():
    """Right-aligned columns with Japanese text should pad correctly."""
    result = render(
        [["a", 123], ["レポート", 4]],
        align=["left", "right"]
    )
    lines = result.split('\n')

    # Second column should be right-aligned
    # Find the pipe position
    pipe_pos = lines[0].index('|')

    # Verify second column in each data line is right-aligned at the same position
    for line in lines[2:]:  # Skip header and separator
        if '|' in line:
            parts = line.split('|')
            # The end of the right-aligned column should be at the same position
            assert len(parts[1].rstrip()) > 0 or '|' in line


def test_japanese_center_aligned():
    """Center-aligned columns with Japanese text should pad correctly."""
    result = render(
        [["ab"], ["日本"]],
        align="center"
    )
    lines = result.split('\n')

    # Both lines should have centered content
    # The visual width of "ab" is 2, "日本" is 4
    # So column width should be 4
    # "ab" centered in 4: " ab " or "ab  " or " ab" (we put extra on right for odd)
    # "日本" centered in 4: "日本" (no padding needed)
    assert len(lines) == 2


def test_japanese_max_width_truncate():
    """max_width should truncate correctly with Japanese characters."""
    result = render(
        [["レポート_レポート", "x"]],
        max_width=8
    )

    # Japanese "レポート" is 4 chars × 2 = 8 visual width
    # With max_width=8, only "レポート" should fit, plus ellipsis makes it 9 visual
    # But the truncation should still work
    lines = result.split('\n')
    assert len(lines) == 1
    assert '…' in lines[0]  # Should have ellipsis


def test_japanese_max_width_multiple_rows():
    """max_width truncation should work consistently across rows with Japanese."""
    result = render(
        [
            ["レポート_2024_v2", 10],
            ["notes", 5]
        ],
        max_width=10
    )
    lines = result.split('\n')

    # Verify separator and data lines have pipes at same positions
    for line in lines:
        if '|' in line:
            # Just verify the line is well-formed
            parts = line.split('|')
            assert len(parts) == 2


def test_japanese_wrap():
    """Wrapping should work correctly with Japanese characters."""
    result = render(
        [["レポート notes テスト", "x"]],
        max_width=12,
        wrap=True
    )

    lines = result.split('\n')
    # Should have multiple lines due to wrapping
    assert len(lines) >= 2


def test_hiragana_alignment():
    """Hiragana characters should align correctly."""
    result = render(
        [["ひらがな", 100], ["test", 10]],
        ["name", "num"]
    )
    lines = result.split('\n')

    # Should have header, separator, and 2 data rows
    assert len(lines) == 4
    # Verify pipes align
    pipe_positions = []
    for line in lines:
        positions = [i for i, char in enumerate(line) if char == '|']
        pipe_positions.append(positions)

    if len(pipe_positions) > 1:
        for positions in pipe_positions[1:]:
            assert positions == pipe_positions[0]

    """Katakana characters should align correctly."""

def test_mixed_width_no_headers():
    """Mixed width characters should align correctly without headers."""
    result = render([
        ["レポート", "abc"],
        ["test", "日本"]
    ])
    lines = result.split('\n')

    # Both rows should have pipes at the same position
    assert len(lines) == 2
    pipe_pos_0 = lines[0].index('|')
    pipe_pos_1 = lines[1].index('|')

def test_japanese_with_numbers():
    """Numbers should right-align even with Japanese text in first column."""
    result = render(
        [["レポート", 1234], ["notes", 5], ["文書", 999]],
        ["name", "KB"]
    )
    lines = result.split('\n')

    # First column is left-aligned (mixed ASCII and Japanese)
    # Second column is right-aligned (all numbers)
    # Pipes should align

        positions = [i for i, char in enumerate(line) if char == '|']
        pipe_positions.append(positions)

    if len(pipe_positions) > 1:

def test_separator_line_width():
    """Separator line should have correct number of dashes for wide characters."""
    result = render(
        [["レポート", 10]],
        ["name", "KB"]
    )
    lines = result.split('\n')

    # lines[0]: header
    # lines[1]: separator
    # lines[2]: data

    header = lines[0]
    separator = lines[1]
    data = lines[2]

    # Count dashes between pipes in separator
    pipe_pos = separator.index('|')
    sep_first_col = separator[:pipe_pos]

    # Should be all dashes (or dashes and +)
    assert all(c in '-+' for c in sep_first_col)


def test_japanese_max_width_ellipsis_placement():
    """Ellipsis should be placed correctly when truncating Japanese text."""
    # Test a string that's purely Japanese and needs truncation
    result = render(
        [["レポート議事録文書テスト", "data"]],
        max_width=8
    )

    lines = result.split('\n')
    # Should contain ellipsis
    assert '…' in lines[0]


def test_empty_cells_with_japanese():
    """Empty cells should not break alignment with Japanese text."""
    result = render(
        [[None, "レポート"], ["notes", None]],
        ["first", "second"]
    )
    lines = result.split('\n')

    # Both columns should still be present and aligned
    for line in lines:
        if '|' in line:
            assert line.count('|') >= 1


def test_very_long_japanese_text():
    """Very long Japanese text should wrap or truncate properly."""
    long_japanese = "レポート" * 10
    result = render(
        [[long_japanese, "x"]],
        max_width=20
    )

    lines = result.split('\n')
    # Should handle the long text
    assert len(lines) >= 1


@pytest.mark.parametrize("japanese_text,ascii_text,num", [
    ("レポート", "notes", 100),
    ("日本語", "text", 50),
    ("テスト", "data", 1),
    ("ひらがな", "sample", 999),
])
def test_japanese_parametrized(japanese_text, ascii_text, num):
    """Parametrized test for various Japanese texts."""
    result = render(
        [[japanese_text, num], [ascii_text, num]],
        ["name", "count"]
    )
    lines = result.split('\n')

    # Should have header, separator, and 2 data rows
    assert len(lines) == 4

    # Pipes should align
    pipe_positions = []
    for line in lines:
        positions = [i for i, char in enumerate(line) if char == '|']
        pipe_positions.append(positions)

    if len(pipe_positions) > 1:
        for positions in pipe_positions[1:]:
            assert positions == pipe_positions[0], f"Pipes don't align with {japanese_text}"
